Natural Language Query: Give me the average and minimum price (in Euro) of the products.
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT AVG(price_in_euros) AS average_price, MIN(price_in_euros) AS minimum_price
FROM Catalog_Contents;

Natural Language Query: What is the product with the highest height? Give me the catalog entry name.
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT catalog_entry_name 
FROM Catalog_Contents 
ORDER BY height DESC 
LIMIT 1;

Natural Language Query: Which catalog content has the highest height? Give me the catalog entry name.
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT MAX(height), catalog_entry_name 
FROM Catalog_Contents 
ORDER BY height DESC 
LIMIT 1;

Natural Language Query: Find the name of the product that has the smallest capacity.
Which catalog content has the smallest capacity? Return the catalog entry name.
Generated SQL Query:
SELECT catalog_entry_name 
FROM Catalog_Contents 
ORDER BY capacity 
LIMIT 1;
